import json, sys
d = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
ri = (d["rollout"].get("metadata") or {}).get("tau2_reward_info") or {}
print("reward", d["score"].get("reward"))
print("reward_basis", ri.get("reward_basis"))
print("db_check", json.dumps(ri.get("db_check"))[:200])
cc = ri.get("communicate_checks") or []
for c in cc:
    print("COMM met=", c.get("met"), "info=", str(c.get("info"))[:160])
nl = ri.get("nl_assertions") or []
for n in nl:
    print("NL met=", n.get("met"), str(n.get("nl") or n.get("info"))[:140])
